title: Fix digest timezone bug — Today count uses UTC vs local date
description: Daily digest header shows local date (e.g. 'Fri 20 Mar') but getLedgerStats todayCount uses UTC date via toISOString(). When UTC is behind local (e.g. UTC=Mar 19, local=Mar 20), Today count shows stale data. Fix by using local date prefix consistently.
